{{Quote|That was an Express-class ''[sic]'' ambassadorial shuttle and it had the markings of the Royal House of Hapes.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], after seeing the ''Thunder Wraith'' lift off|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
The '''''Thunder Wraith''''' was a [[Hapan]] [[Express-class ambassadorial shuttle|''Express''-class ambassadorial shuttle]] which contained spacious, elegant, and well-equipped passenger quarters with several massive [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreens]]. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] had the markings of the [[Hapan Royal House]] on the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] and was capable of traveling in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Lightsabers" /> In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'' to [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]].</ref> [[Ta'a Chume]], the [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarch]] of [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], ordered [[Yfra]], her personal [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]], to pick up [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], the Hapan-[[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Prince/Legends|princess]], from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] after Tenel Ka had lost most of her left [[Limb/Legends|arm]] when her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] exploded. Yfra picked up Tenel Ka in the ''Thunder Wraith'' in the middle of the [[Standard day/Legends|night]] and transported her to Hapes where Chume, her grandmother, was waiting.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Thunder Wraith'' appeared in the [[1996]] ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'' by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]] as the fourth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights]]'' series.<ref name="Lightsabers" />
